next_step_summary: PR #250 completes the currently classified six-family CORE Question Engine inventory sequence by adding the pre-signing option / renewal mechanism. The bounded slice keeps renewal right structure, period, economics, activation, prerequisites, external dependencies, and cross-clause interaction separate without assuming that every renewal clause creates a unilateral option. No statutory/case-law interpretation, conditional execution, LLM/provider integration, UI, OCR, Android, serverless, storage, dependencies, permissions, workflows, or network access is added. Before any next implementation layer, the owner-requested bounded step is a periodic Codex batch audit of the accumulated Question Engine work, following docs/CODEX_WORKFLOW.md and recording the inspected SHA/PR range, findings, validation actually run, and any bounded corrective PRs.
